description: Probe-only rejection library for HIP_MLOPS_ENGINE RMSNorm forward (runs on gfx950; no arch gate in the engine, RMSnormPlanBuilder.cpp:80-209). Template: quick RMSNorm/Default (training phase, with bias and the inv_rms output), not Variant4: Variant4 is inference with no inv_rms key, and node_patches cannot add a key, so the inv_rms dtype family needs the training template. Every case is a graph the frontend accepts (RMSNormNode.hpp pre_validate: x and scale rank >= 2, scale[0] == 1 with a non-empty normalized suffix, inv_rms 1 on normalized axes and x's size elsewhere). Classes covered: mixed dtypes, int32/uint32 overflow, odd dims, rank, declared alignment. Non-dense and padded strides are out of scope. There is no unsupported-attribute family: compute_data_type, forward_phase and is_override_shape_enabled are node- or graph-level template literals that node_patches cannot reach, and a two-node graph (RMSNorm plus pointwise) cannot be wired from this template. `expect` is `declined` where the engine code shows it must decline or, for a gap, would compute something else, and `declined_or_pass` where a correct engine may take the graph and the references can grade it (the (x, scale, y) combinations of RMSNormFwdSignatureKey.hpp getPlanBuilders). none: the control, pure float/half/bfloat16 with a float inv_rms, rank 4 or 5, scale and bias covering the trailing axes from k: `declined_or_pass`. odd_dims: every dim of x not divisible by 4; no divisibility gate in the engine: `declined_or_pass`. dt_scale_f: x and y half or bfloat16 with float scale and bias (registered combination); the plan types x, y and scale separately (RMSnormFwdPlan.cpp:155-176): `declined_or_pass`. dt_y_f: x half or bfloat16 with float y (registered): `declined_or_pass`. dt_scale_bias: scale and bias differ in dtype; all affine tensors must share one dtype (RMSnormApplicabilityChecks.cpp:61-69): `declined`. dt_invrms: inv_rms is half, bfloat16 or double; statistics must be FLOAT (RMSnormApplicabilityChecks.cpp:72-78): `declined`. dt_x_bad, dt_y_bad: x or y is int32, double or uint8; io tensors must be float, half or bfloat16 (RMSnormApplicabilityChecks.cpp:47-59): `declined`. dt_affine_bad: scale and bias of such a dtype (:61-69): `declined`. rank_2, rank_3, rank_6: rank 2, 3 or 6 with the last axis normalized, packed row-major; the engine takes rank 4 or 5 only (ApplicabilityChecks.cpp:31-41 validateDimensionCount via RMSnormApplicabilityChecks.cpp:21-37 and :164-187 (call at :184)): `declined`. align: every device tensor declares the same alignment (1, 2, 4 or 8 bytes; powers of two only, because the backend rejects an execute whose pointer is not a multiple of the declared alignment, hip_kernel_provider_common/DeclaredAlignment.hpp:14-17); a tensor whose declared alignment is not a multiple of its element size makes the engine decline (RMSnormPlanBuilder.cpp:100-108, DeclaredAlignment.hpp:79-84). inv_rms is always float, so the case is `declined` when the alignment is not a multiple of 2 or (not a multiple of 4 and some tensor is float, always true here), else `declined_or_pass`. overflow: `ovf` selects x_2_31 and x_2_32 (2**31 / 2**32 elements), inner_2_31 / inner_2_32 (one row of that many elements) and outer_2_32 (2**32 rows), built at enforcement_level buildable. isApplicable has no overflow gate; the kernels take their sizes as unsigned int constants and index with unsigned products (RMSNormFwd.cpp:7-9, gid and o are unsigned int at :29-31; RMSNormBwd.cpp:8-9,46 for the backward kernel), and buildPlan throws only when outerSize * stride >= UINT32_MAX (RMSnormFwdPlan.cpp:140-145), so outer_2_32 ends in a build exception (a CRASH finding) and the others are accepted by the engine: all `declined` (known gaps; an accepted and built case is reported UNEXERCISED with the reason `accepted above the oracle ceiling`). The epsilon value is not checked by the engine and is not probed (it is a template tensor). The space is written for gfx950, the only device available; the engine runs there. It is probe-only: never frozen into a bundle. Axes (few on purpose, so the pairwise proof stays cheap): `family`; `shape` (ndim, n, c, d3, h, w, first normalized axis k, layout: 8 combinations covering rank 4 and 5, NCHW and NHWC and every split k); `odd` (n, c, d, h, w, none divisible by 4, read only by odd_dims); `x_dtype` (the base dtype of the pure families); `aux` (low-precision dtype, unsupported dtype, declared alignment, saved statistics, inv_rms dtype: 8 combinations, each family reads only the components it needs); `ovf` (the overflow variants).

derive.rank_r: 2 if family == 'rank_2' else (3 if family == 'rank_3' else 6)
derive.dd: (odd_d if is_odd else d3) if ndim == 5 else 1
derive.xs_h: ww if layout == 'nchw' else ww * cc
derive.xs_d: hh * ww if layout == 'nchw' else hh * ww * cc
derive.xs_c: dd * hh * ww if layout == 'nchw' else 1
derive.ps_h: pw if layout == 'nchw' else pw * pc
derive.ps_d: ph * pw if layout == 'nchw' else ph * pw * pc
derive.ps_c: pd * ph * pw if layout == 'nchw' else 1
derive.ss_h: sw if layout == 'nchw' else sw * sc
derive.ss_d: sh * sw if layout == 'nchw' else sh * sw * sc
derive.ss_c: sd * sh * sw if layout == 'nchw' else 1
derive.b_dims_x: [nn, cc, hh, ww] if ndim == 4 else [nn, cc, dd, hh, ww]
derive.b_dims_p: [1, pc, ph, pw] if ndim == 4 else [1, pc, pd, ph, pw]
derive.b_dims_s: [nn, sc, sh, sw] if ndim == 4 else [nn, sc, sd, sh, sw]
derive.b_str_x: [xs_n, xs_c, xs_h, xs_w] if ndim == 4 else [xs_n, xs_c, xs_d, xs_h, xs_w]
derive.b_str_p: [ps_n, ps_c, ps_h, ps_w] if ndim == 4 else [ps_n, ps_c, ps_d, ps_h, ps_w]
derive.b_str_s: [ss_n, ss_c, ss_h, ss_w] if ndim == 4 else [ss_n, ss_c, ss_d, ss_h, ss_w]
derive.r_dims_x: [nn, ww] if rank_r == 2 else ([nn, cc, ww] if rank_r == 3 else [nn, cc, dd, hh, 2, ww])
derive.r_dims_p: [1, ww] if rank_r == 2 else ([1, 1, ww] if rank_r == 3 else [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, ww])
derive.r_dims_s: [nn, 1] if rank_r == 2 else ([nn, cc, 1] if rank_r == 3 else [nn, cc, dd, hh, 2, 1])
derive.r_str_x: [ww, 1] if rank_r == 2 else ([cc * ww, ww, 1] if rank_r == 3 else [cc * dd * hh * 2 * ww, dd * hh * 2 * ww, hh * 2 * ww, 2 * ww, ww, 1])
derive.r_str_p: [ww, 1] if rank_r == 2 else ([ww, ww, 1] if rank_r == 3 else [ww, ww, ww, ww, ww, 1])
derive.r_str_s: [1, 1] if rank_r == 2 else ([cc, 1, 1] if rank_r == 3 else [cc * dd * hh * 2, dd * hh * 2, hh * 2, 2, 1, 1])
derive.ob: 2**32 if ovf == 'outer_2_32' else (1 if ovf in ['inner_2_31', 'inner_2_32'] else 2)
derive.ow: 2**15 if ovf in ['x_2_31', 'x_2_32'] else (2**31 if ovf == 'inner_2_31' else (2**32 if ovf == 'inner_2_32' else 4))
derive.dims_x: [ob, 1, oh, ow] if ov else (r_dims_x if rk else b_dims_x)
derive.dims_p: [1, 1, 1, ow] if ov else (r_dims_p if rk else b_dims_p)
derive.dims_s: [ob, 1, oh, 1] if ov else (r_dims_s if rk else b_dims_s)
derive.stride_x: [oh * ow, oh * ow, ow, 1] if ov else (r_str_x if rk else b_str_x)
derive.stride_p: [ow, ow, ow, 1] if ov else (r_str_p if rk else b_str_p)
derive.stride_s: [oh, oh, 1, 1] if ov else (r_str_s if rk else b_str_s)
derive.nd: 1 if (rk or ov) else ndim - k
derive.ty: 'float' if family == 'dt_y_f' else (bad_dt if family == 'dt_y_bad' else d0)
derive.tp: bad_dt if family == 'dt_affine_bad' else ('float' if mixed else d0)
derive.unc: family == 'align' and (al % 2 != 0 or (al % 4 != 0 and 'float' in [tx, ty, tp, tb, ti]))

expect: ${'declined_or_pass' if (family in ['none', 'odd_dims', 'dt_scale_f', 'dt_y_f'] or (family == 'align' and not unc)) else 'declined'}
